summary: The go-host resolver now reads enabled campaigns from the database through MarketingLinks.resolve and returns 500 on database errors. The static marketingLinks/HALO_MARKETING_LINKS configuration is removed from the config schema, the server and Pulumi. In the working tree, go-host isolation now matches on hostname whatever port the Host header carries, for both requests and upgrades. The durable test covers create, update, disable, re-enable and delete through the public host, including port variants and WebSocket upgrade rejection, and a temp test covers the 500 path on a closed database. All changed lines are covered and I found no blocking issue. One minor non-blocking item: Pulumi.prod.yaml line 8 still has the stale comment "Add the actual slug-to-UTM mappings here", which should be removed.
